limitations: Only retained C archives inspected; D archive and external-root historical bytes remain parent checks.
Canonical source/output build binding was attested by parent before next build; this script checks retained receipt/output attestations, never live binaries.
One process per build with three within-process repetitions; no independent-process statistical significance.
Actual cache ingress TTL can expire; warm-requested groups retain actual prime age/hits/misses and do not claim warm qualification.
Prime rows are ingress only and have no independent post-quiet storage witness.
RouteSkipped retains original S_FALSE and original detail; absent/unpaired conditional routes are never qualified.
Native fixture protects foreground at boundaries; no continuous foreground history or post-exit leak proof.
Global sandbox audit remains raw, including historical foreign issues; no global-clean or I27 completion assertion.
Root must review every adverse direction and exact fixture/source comparability; no threshold waiver, rebaseline or automatic performance pass.
qualification: Root assessment required; no statistical non-regression verdict.
